verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of dependency tracking. The closest vendor claims are generic: agents that spot risks and progress gaps, a cross-platform view of work, and linking GitHub/GitLab PRs to items. One hands-on user report confirms that tickets can be linked to one another in monday.com, but says this linking is 'really bad' and that 'data gets lost all the time'. That makes the support thin and unreliable for coordinating a large launch. Missing for 10: documented dependency columns or links between items across boards and teams, a timeline or Gantt view that shows dependencies, dependency-aware scheduling or alerts, and independent evidence that cross-team linking works reliably.
